title: StreetAccess
description: Vehicle access of one street segment from Road Check. These are the `properties` of a GeoJSON Feature whose geometry is a LineString or MultiLineString in EPSG:4326.

osm_way_id.description: OpenStreetMap way id of the street.

edge_id.description: Optional segment id '<way>-<u>-<v>' (OSM node ids, smaller first) when a way is split at junctions.

u.description: OSM node id at the start of the segment (geometry runs u -> v). With v and a connected network, lets the screen route crews.

v.description: OSM node id at the end of the segment.

near_place.description: Nearest named place; used to label unnamed streets.

fire_distance_km.description: Distance to the fire extent; far streets are drawn faint.

status.description: open: free width >= 3 m; special_access: 2 m to under 3 m; blocked: under 2 m.

valid_at.description: UTC time from which `status` holds. Before it the screen shows `status_before`. Omit for a status that holds for the whole scenario.

basis.description: What the status is based on: Road Check imagery, the fire model's road-closure calculation, or an operator's entry.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the status.

free_width_m.description: Estimated free width in metres (Road Check). null when the status does not come from imagery.

imagery_date.description: Date of the drone or aerial image the estimate comes from. null when basis is not imagery.

imagery_source.description: Image id and licence, e.g. an OpenAerialMap id.

source.description: Tool, model or archive that produced the record.

source_url.description: Link to the original record, page or repository.

fetched_at.description: When the producing tool fetched or exported the record (UTC).

observed_at.description: When the thing happened in the world (UTC).

synthetic.description: true for invented sample data; the screen labels such records SYNTHETIC.
